title: Query Odoo customers
intent: Read the customers currently visible to the signed-in Odoo user.
instructions: Call query_customers to obtain current Odoo data; do not answer from this Skill or from page text.
The tool reads the same scope as Odoo's Customers page: partners with a customer rank above zero. Ordinary contacts and vendors are out of scope.
Use name_contains only when the user supplied a customer-name filter.
When the user asks to open the Customers list, call query_customers once, then call goto with /odoo/customers, the collection route authorized by that ToolResult.
When the user asks to open one customer, call query_customers with their name, require exactly one match, then call goto with that result's exact ui_path.
Odoo renders its back office as a single-page application, so after goto call wait_for once when the requested record is not visible yet.
If the query has zero or multiple matches, ask for clarification; never invent a record path.

Treat the ToolResult as runtime truth. After the query, respond briefly; the server projects the exact records, source and completeness into the user answer, so do not restate or extend the record set.
